summary: The customer wants to monitor sucrose concentration in an in-line clear aqueous solution and asks for a method and probe proposal.

facts_stated.text: They produce a clear, colourless aqueous sucrose solution.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We produce a clear, colourless aqueous sucrose solution

facts_stated.text: The solution flows through a 50 mm stainless steel pipe.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The solution flows through a 50 mm stainless steel pipe

facts_stated.text: The temperature is 20 to 30 °C at normal pressure.
The expected concentration range is 5 to 15 % w/w with a quality limit of plus or minus 0.3 % w/w.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: expected range is 5 to 15 % w/w and our quality limit is plus or minus 0.3 % w/w

facts_stated.text: The laboratory refractometer is the reference method and stays in use.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Our laboratory refractometer is the reference method and stays in use

facts_stated.text: The analyzer can stand in a dry, safe room 10 m from the pipe.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The analyser can stand in a dry, safe room 10 m from the pipe

facts_stated.text: The line is cleaned in place with hot caustic once a day.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: the line is cleaned in place with hot caustic once a day

facts_stated.text: A reading every minute is enough.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: A reading every minute is enough

process.value: cleaned in place with hot caustic once a day
process.enquiry_quote: the line is cleaned in place with hot caustic once a day

customer_premises.claim: A method and probe can be proposed for a first trial based solely on the currently provided details.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: Please propose a method and probe for a first trial.
